# Vinayak Bhardwaj

> Founder of Virin Digital in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. Designs and hand-builds websites, builds AI agent workflows and automation for businesses, produces long-form documentaries on the YouTube channel Vinayak Tech, and is developing 12 Taneh, a mobile strategy game for Android. Every project goes through the same loop: brief, build, check, ship.

## Services (Kuala Lumpur)

- Websites: hand-built sites for founders and service businesses, fast on phones and readable by search engines and AI assistants.
- AI agent workflows and automation: manual processes such as lead intake, reporting or document checks, rebuilt as agent pipelines with a checking step and a cost cap.
- Documentary and explainer video: research from primary documents, motion graphics in Remotion, audio mastered to -14 LUFS.

## Projects

- Staff evaluation platform (client project, 2026): role-based scorecards with a safety gate, a private staff profile form that scores people automatically, and an owner overview; built for a Kuala Lumpur façade-maintenance and hospitality group and in use by its staff. React, TypeScript, Postgres.
- Virin Digital: his studio, founded January 2024. Website: https://www.virindigital.com/
- Vinayak Tech: YouTube channel with six long-form episodes since September 2026. https://www.youtube.com/@Vinayak_ai_tech
- 12 Taneh (also Bara Tehni, Alquerque Royale): traditional South Asian strategy board game rebuilt for Android with four AI opponents, daily puzzles and offline play. In testing, coming to Google Play.
- vinayakbhardwaj.com: hand-built, scoring 99–100 in Google Lighthouse on every page.

## Facts

- Base: Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, since September 2018.
- Background: eight years in mechanical engineering and QA/QC; B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Sharda University.
- Languages: English, Bahasa Melayu, Hindi, Punjabi.
